entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who fed on Alara's mana to stave off the post-Mending crumbling of his mind and body, and who works his schemes from the sidelines.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who acted on Zendikar as Bolas's instrument.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose mana Bolas fed on.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane where Bolas was active through Sarkhan.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event after which Bolas's mind and body began to crumble.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane made of metal, suffused with artifacts, born from a golem creator and orbited by a handful of mana suns.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane whose faeries have insect-like wings and legs.

events.summary: Bolas fed on the power of Alara's mana, holding off the crumbling of his mind and body after the Mending.
events.quote: By feeding on the power of Alara's mana, Bolas forestalled the post-Mending crumbling of his mind and body for a time

events.summary: Bolas was active on Zendikar through his instrument Sarkhan.
events.quote: he was active there through his instrument Sarkhan the Mad

relations.note: Sarkhan is described as Bolas's instrument.
relations.quote: he was active there through his instrument Sarkhan the Mad
